index.title: Test1 documentation 0.9
index.description: The pages as they stood before the 1.0 program model.
index.html:
This is the documentation as it stood for the 0.9 build. It is kept because machines in the field still run it, and because a page that changes should leave the old wording behind rather than overwrite it.

What is different in 1.0

The program model changed: 1.0 downloads without stopping control, and 0.9 does not. If you are reading this version because the machine says 0.9, everything on this page still applies; if you are commissioning a new machine, read 1.0 instead.
